title: a16z Podcast: The History and Future of Machine Learning

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: How have we gotten to where were are with machine learning?
reader_summary.overview: How have we gotten to where were are with machine learning? a16z Operating Partner Frank Chen and Carnegie Mellon professor Tom Mitchell first stroll down memory lane, visiting the major landmarks: the symbolic approach of the 1970s. Then they go on to explore the frontiers of research.
